name: Tenma Hasumi
source:
She has the looks and personality of a friendly honor student and is quite popular as a result. Due to her curiosity, lack of fear, and perhaps her somewhat spoiled upbringing, her tastes are a little different than most girls her age. She has a characteristic "nyuhuhu" laugh that the protagonist finds unsettling. Loves to eat. Her favorite foods are cheese, ramen, and cheese ramen. She's starting to get a little concerned about her weight. When she runs into the protagonist on the street late one night, she asks him to be her friend.

[From [url=https://koikari.nekonyansoft.com/character/chara2.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
